complicacoes.texto: Deathstroke has personal vendettas contra both Green Arrow e Nightwing (see Vol. II ).
Being the best there is at what he does.
Deathstroke has had a series of tumultuous romances, first com his wife Adeline, then later com Terra (see Vol. II ), e former police officer Pat Trayce, the second Vigilante (see Vol. II ).

Rose Wilson, the new Ravager (see Vol. II ), e her brother Joseph, the Titan known as Jericho, are Slade’s two surviving children. They are all that remains of Slade’s broken family. Though he tries to manipulate them, Slade cares for his children in his own twisted, obsessive way. They may yet prove to be Slade’s greatest weakness.
While Deathstroke can regenerate from even the most mortal of wounds, recovering from the Moribundo condition renders him insane e animalistic for a short period of time.
